title: One hero piece
body: Let one thing lead: a heavy border, a sequin top or statement earrings. If the outfit is busy, keep jewellery quiet, and the other way round.

title: Balance the volume
body: Big bottoms (lehenga, palazzo, flares) need a fitted top. An oversized top needs a slim bottom.

title: Match metal to mood
body: Gold and kundan with silks and warm colours; oxidised silver with cotton, ikat and indigo; silver and diamonds with cool tones and sequins.

title: Fabric follows weather
body: Cotton, linen, chanderi and mulmul for Indian summers. Silk, velvet and brocade for winter weddings. Georgette and chiffon travel well.

title: Dress for the venue
body: Covered shoulders for temples and poojas, breathable flowy pieces for beaches, structure for offices and interviews.

title: Tailor with your shoes on
body: Floor-length outfits should just graze the floor in the footwear you will wear. Pick shoes first, then hem.
